edge_summary: Long-only portfolio of 6 positive-Sharpe assets with near-zero pairwise correlations, tilted toward a03 (Sharpe 1.67, vol 0.0126) which dominates on risk-adjusted terms. Excluding a05/a06/a08/a09 due to Sharpe <0.25, extreme drawdowns, or negative drift. The low inter-asset correlation (max |ρ|≈0.18) means diversification benefit is real even in a concentrated book.
reasoning: Weights are Sharpe-proportional with a03 capped at 0.30 to avoid single-name concentration beyond 30%. Rebalance weekly (every 5 bars) when any weight drifts >0.03 from target; on non-rebalance bars only trade if gap >0.05. Kill-switch: if portfolio drawdown from peak exceeds 15% reduce all target weights to 0.50 (half exposure); if drawdown exceeds 25% go flat. No position in a05 (Sharpe 0.25), a06 (Sharpe 0.04, max_dd -0.74), a08 (Sharpe -0.37), a09 (Sharpe -0.00, max_dd -1.10). Gross exposure target 1.00, no leverage. Sizing per leg uses floor(cash_alloc / approx_price) with residual cash swept on next rebalance.
